crossRefs.note: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.
Blow the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, for the…

translations.web: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.
translations.bsb: To convene the assembly, you are to sound long blasts, not short ones.
translations.kjv: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.
translations.asv: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.
